subject: Kickoff - DBLE as our calibration layer
body:
Team,

Kicking off DBLE. The premise from our open-source release: adapt prototypical learning so the representation space has a usable metric, then calibrate confidence by how far a sample sits from its class center. Since you don't have ground-truth labels at inference, you train a second confidence model - and crucially you train it only on the mis-classified training samples, which the paper shows is what makes it work.

Why now: three teams route automated decisions off classifier confidence, and all three are using raw softmax, which is famously overconfident. A model-agnostic calibration layer that works on MLPs, VGG and ResNet alike is worth a quarter of our time.

Apr 27 - Aug 10:
- Jun 5: reproduce the reported calibration improvements, ResNet-50 on the standard image sets.
- Jul 10: apply to two internal classifiers, measure expected calibration error against temperature scaling.
- Aug 5: recommendation + integration plan.

Alina has resourcing. Carmen tech lead.

Dmitri
